instruction: Upload the 'Receipt-2709-5620.pdf' attachment from the Twitter receipt email in Thunderbird to Google Drive, renaming it to 'X_Platform_Receipt_2024.pdf'.

query: title = 'X_Platform_Receipt_2024.pdf' and trashed = false and 'root' in parents

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting PDF attachment and uploading to Google Drive with a new filename. Reuses custom getter/metric from variation 2 to verify file exists on Google Drive with correct name and minimum size.
metadata.verification: Verified from Thunderbird profile: email contains Receipt-2709-5620.pdf. Evaluator checks file uploaded to Google Drive with new filename.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_gdrive_file__6bd409d3 second parameter type (dict) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator verifies file exists on Google Drive with correct name (via query) and meets minimum size requirement
File name verification is implicit through query filter rather than explicit in metric - if file is found, it must have correct name 'X_Platform_Receipt_2024.pdf'
Cannot verify file content - only checks size (min 5KB), so any file with correct name and sufficient size would pass
Cannot verify the file is actually the specific receipt from Thunderbird email - no content hash, MIME type check, or origin verification
Minimum size threshold (5000 bytes) is reasonable for PDF but doesn't guarantee it's the correct receipt
Getter logic is correct - uses get_googledrive_file to download and verify file existence locally
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add file content verification using checksum/hash of the original Receipt-2709-5620.pdf from Thunderbird profile
Verify MIME type is 'application/pdf' to ensure it's actually a PDF file
Consider adding expected file size range based on actual receipt size rather than just minimum threshold
Add explicit filename check in metric function to make verification more transparent
Consider verifying file modification time is recent (uploaded during task execution)
